_meta.scope: Stored PathSolver shards only; simulation bookkeeping, no RF measurement, no statement about why a path is missing.

table.name: isolated_20xmedian
table.formula: m = component-wise median of E, median(Re E) + j·median(Im E); d = \|E − m\|; isolated ⟺ d > 20·median(d). Also: counts at ×10 and ×40; normaliser median(d); \|m\|; z = d/median(d); gap = largest z below the threshold vs smallest z above it; normaliser-free median \|E−m\|/\|m\| of isolated positions; isolated positions with \|E\| below / at-or-above \|m\|.
table.notes: The normaliser is per cell, so the same count can mean very different event sizes between cells.

table.name: hampel_w51_k5
table.formula: on x = \|E\|: local median and MAD in a sliding window of 51 positions (2.59 ms), edges reflect-padded; marked ⟺ \|x − local median\| > 5·1.4826·MAD

table.name: env_field_drop_halfmedian
table.source: make_0917_v16.py notes / jobs_0954 header wording; reference cell chosen here
table.notes: Column 'same cap': open-sky cell with the same build, elevation, azimuth, drone, depth, rays, pattern, orientation, aim offset and cap (rep 0, seed 1), else 'no reference'. Column 'sky at default cap': the same but the open-sky cell at the default cap; used only where labelled. A field-threshold count: it is not a path list.

table.name: env_path_missing
table.formula: an environment-only path key present at a non-isolated neighbour position and absent at the position
table.notes: From path lists only; not computable from shards. Section 4 reads the existing lists.

table.name: copy_k_ratio
table.formula: k = round(\|E\| / \|E_dedup\|); modal k over positions; also the count of positions with k ≠ n_dup + 1 and max \|E − k·E_dedup\|/\|E_dedup\|
table.notes: Exact only when the removed copies dominate the field; mixed fields give non-integer ratios.

table.name: copy_k_diff
table.formula: k = 1 + \|E − E_dedup\| / \|one copy\|; \|one copy\| = median over positions with n_dup ≥ 1 of \|E − E_dedup\|/n_dup in the 0° open-sky cell of the same build, drone, depth and rays (default cap, iso)
table.notes: Meaningful where the removed line is the drone echo of that 0° cell.

table.name: n_dup
table.formula: number of path rows removed as duplicates at the position (stored by the sweep)
table.notes: k = n_dup + 1 is the third copy-count estimator.

table.name: S
table.formula: positions whose copy_k_ratio is below its modal value (index set kept); also S from n_dup + 1
table.notes: Short-position count; not an isolation count.

table.name: contrast_raw / contrast_dedup / contrast_interp
table.formula: 10·log10(mean P over comb bins / mean P over other non-DC bins); P = \|FFT(x − mean x)/n\|², rectangular window, full record; comb = ± harmonics 1…12 of f_flash, ±2 bins each (±4.81 Hz), i.e. up to ±1520 Hz of the ±9,850 Hz span; x = E, E_dedup, or E with hampel_w51_k5 positions replaced by linear interpolation of neighbours (drop_outliers)
table.notes: Not a received SNR or a detection gain. Interpolation does not recover the true value at replaced positions.
